description: Uncut's bundled sound effects (D134, D208, D250): CC0 1.0 (public domain) sounds from Freesound and Kenney, each licence checked when the pack is made (the Freesound page's licence link, the Kenney pack's License.txt), and Uncut's own synthesised sounds (scripts/sfx-synth.ts). Levelled to -20 LUFS integrated, sample peak at most -1 dBFS, AAC 112k. Made by scripts/make-sfx.ts.
